about: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited produces and supplies petroleum products in India. The company provides liquefied petroleum gas, naphtha, motor gasoline and spirit, kerosene, aviation turbine fuel, automotive high-speed and high flash diesel, light diesel oil, and bunker and non-bunker fuel oil. It also offers lube products, such as paving bitumen, lube oil base stocks, and extracts. In addition, the company provides paraffin wax, mineral turpentine oil, food grade and pharma grade hexane,
